summary:
Implementation plan to convert the platform into a Standalone Android Mobile Application with an Embedded Local Server:
1. Remove startup sign-in/sign-up login barriers: direct instant access on any device with automatic device UUID binding.
2. Complete session & data isolation: each device runs its own isolated local session sandbox and SQLite storage so no external web user can ever view or hijack another device's WhatsApp credentials.
3. Standalone React Native Android Project Architecture with embedded Node/Baileys server bridge, Android manifest, foreground service, and local device storage.
4. Keep all features (Live Location, Fake Quote, Scheduled Queue, Buttons, Tracker, PTV) active and running locally on device.
